fusions.name: Steady Trot
fusions.desc: Stamps a quick trot around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises by 10% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Trampling Rush
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles onto the target and trample it for 15 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Stout Heart
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Reserves
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 5 stamina a second for 6 seconds. Once every 24 seconds.
